text:
Laura Chen: quick question — opened a tiny PR to the ruby SDK to simplify the Gemfile in examples/ruby/quickstart and add a one-liner onboarding note. CI is failing on bundler 2.4 in the matrix though, curious if anyone has seen that error before
Mike O'Neill: link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/412 — failing job: `bundle install` 
CI Bot: Job failed on ruby-3.2 / bundler-2.4 — error: could not resolve dependency 'concurrent-ruby' (exit code 5) 
Kavita Rao: hmm we pin concurrent-ruby indirectly via the gemspec. Did the PR bump any transitive deps? 
Laura Chen: no code changes besides docs and Gemfile tweak. Gemfile currently has:
```
source 'https://rubygems.org'
gem 'redwood', '~> 0.3.0'
```
I changed to a looser pin to match the published gem, but CI started failing after that.
Mike O'Neill: try adding a conservative update: `bundle update redwood --conservative` in the CI script, sometimes resolves transitive constraints without full unlock.
Kavita Rao: also check the lockfile commit. If examples include Gemfile.lock it can cause oddities across bundler versions. For quickstart, we usually avoid committing lockfile so users get current deps.
Laura Chen: good call — I had committed Gemfile.lock to the `examples/ruby` directory by accident. Removing it fixed local `bundle install` for me. I'll push a fix and re-run CI. :+1:
devex-bot: FYI, tiny doc changes usually land as patch releases unless they change the public API. See release checklist: https://go/redwood/devex/release-guidelines
Laura Chen: question for release: should we bump the gem to 0.3.1 for docs & quickstart only, or wait for next minor? I can include a changelog entry.
Mike O'Neill: docs-only -> patch (0.3.1), but add a note in the changelog that examples/quickstart had lockfile removed to improve onboarding. Keeps downstream reproducibility clear. :memo:
Kavita Rao: also add a sentence in CONTRIBUTING.md re: don't commit example lockfiles and add a CI lint that flags them. Low friction win for onboarding.
Laura Chen: will do. I'll update the PR and ping for review after CI passes. Thanks all.
Mike O'Neill: quick nit — in the sample app README you used `Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])` can we prefer the `ENV.fetch` pattern so beginners see immediate failure if unset? e.g., `api_key = ENV.fetch('REDWOOD_API_KEY')`
Laura Chen: good point, will swap that in.
CI Bot: Build passed on retry (ruby-3.2, bundler-2.4).
Laura Chen: PR updated, removed Gemfile.lock, switched to ENV.fetch, added CONTRIBUTING note, and changelog entry. cc @Mike O'Neill @Kavita Rao for final thumbs.
Mike O'Neill: :thumbsup:
Kavita Rao: :eyes: LGTM once changelog formatting is tidy.
Laura Chen: merging after 30m if no objections. Thanks everyone!
